column3: (Cookie No HttpOnly - only the XSRF-TOKEN cookie: the double-submit CSRF pattern requires the client to read and echo it; the session cookies are HttpOnly)

(Storable and Cacheable Content - hashed assets are immutable by design, the document is no-cache)
